source.title: Anthropic's appetite for compute is pushing xAI toward a rent-over-build strategy
source.text: Since May, SpaceXSI has been renting compute to competitors like Anthropic and Google while scaling back its own AI projects. Anthropic pays about $3.1 billion a month, Google $800 million, the New York Times reports. After its June IPO, SpaceXSI disbanded the 60-person Grok Imagine team, among other cuts. The article Anthropic's appetite for compute is pushing xAI toward a rent-over-build strategy appeared first on The Decoder .

Anthropic is paying about $3.1 billion a month to rent compute from SpaceXSI, according to a New York Times report.

Google is also paying $800 million a month as SpaceXSI scales back its own AI projects. Following its June IPO, SpaceXSI disbanded its 60-person Grok Imagine team.

Should AI companies focus on renting out compute or building their own models?
